text:
alex: Heads-up: scheduling a low-impact maintenance window tomorrow 03:30-04:00 UTC to deploy a NIC firmware + netdriver tweak to reduce packet drops on long-lived tensor routes. Targeting a small cohort (B) of US-West GPU racks only. Plan below — pls review.
ops-bot: Maintenance created: 2024-06-18T03:30:00Z -> 2024-06-18T04:00:00Z (cohort B). Auto-notify enabled. :bell:
maya: Quick q — does this touch Dedicated pools or Private? We have a dedicated customer with reserved capacity in us-west.
ajordan: Not Dedicated. We'll exclude reserved GPU pools (tag: reserved=true) and only cordon/evac schedulable worker nodes. Reserved tenants are on the exclude list in the rollout script.
alex: Correct — reserved pools unaffected. Affected = scheduler-managed saturn-gpu pools (cohort B tag). Evac plan uses graceful drain + backfill to prewarmed standby nodes.
maya: Can we pre-warm KV cache and batchers before handoff? Last time cold KV caused latency blips for small chat workloads.
ajordan: Yes — plan includes a 10m preheat step: spawn 6 priming pods per pool to hit usual seq len distribution. Will seed kvcache prefixes for top-10 tenant prompts.
alex: Runbook excerpt:
```bash
# cordon + drain for node i
kubectl cordon node/usw2-gpu-0$i
kubectl drain node/usw2-gpu-0$i --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60
# spin up prewarm pods (example)
kubectl apply -f prewarm-usw2-cohortB.yaml
```
ops-bot: Note: rolling window will do max 4 nodes concurrently. Autoscaler pause and backfill circuits will be triggered.
sre-jen: Add a canary step: pick 2 nodes from cohort B (low load slice) and run the full drill; wait 15m telemetry check (token latency P95, error-rate, packet-drop). If metrics good, continue. If >3% request errors or P95 latency > baseline+30ms -> abort.
tim: FYI cost impact if we spill to Hosted standby: estimated additional compute credits ~2.5k for the window assuming 400 small jobs moved for 30m. Logging and tracing retention spike ~10% (short term).
customer-success: Quick heads-up: will notify the two customers running long jobs in us-west about potential minor blips during the canary. They requested earliest low-traffic window, this matches.
maya: One more — network teams, confirm egress ACLs unchanged? Last NIC firmware hit a filter rule and we had transient failures to S3.
ajordan: I've pulled a config diff and net team verified no ACL changes. We're only changing firmware + driver parameters (rx-coalesce tuning).
sre-jen: I'll add rollback hooks to the console: if packet drops >0.5% (15m) auto trigger kernel fallback and instant reroute to cohort C.
alex: Great. @oncall please stand by during the window and escalate if any canary fails. I'll post a status thread during the rollout.
ops-bot: @oncall added: ena_sre. Reminder will ping 10m before start.
customer-success: acked, we'll send the customer note now and link to status page.
alex: Thanks everyone. Proceeding with canary tomorrow 03:30 UTC. I'll post final go/no-go 10m prior. :white_check_mark:
